subject: physics
content: Your friend is having eye sight problem. She is not able to see clearly a distant uniform window mesh and it appears to her as non-uniform and distorted. The doctor diagnosed the problem as :
explanation:
Myopia with Astigmatism causes distant objects to
be blurry and distorted.
